## CEO overview

- **What is changing:** Firstmate gains read-only release receipt automation that observes Coolify or Render deployments and App DB migration ledger entries against an intended commit, then stores a redacted receipt when the cut is verified.
- **Why it matters:** After authorizing a production release, operators had no single bounded check confirming the live app, build id, and migrations all match before calling the release complete.
- **Customer or business impact:** Operators can verify production releases without triggering new deploys or exposing credentials; a healthy app with missing migrations stays visibly distinct from a fully verified release.
- **Risk and rollout:** The observer is read-only, reuses existing credential paths and the watcher check pattern, and includes behavioral tests for rollout edge cases. Live end-to-end verification was inconclusive in CI because Coolify returned HEAD instead of a commit SHA and App DB credentials were unavailable in the gate environment.

## What changed technically

- Added bin/fm-release-receipt-check.sh with check, run, audit, arm, and disarm actions that read-only observe Coolify or Render deployments and the App DB migration ledger against a JSON manifest, then store a redacted receipt in state/.release-receipt.
- Integrated with the existing watcher check pattern via arm and disarm, reusing established Coolify, Render, and Supabase credential paths; only app=healthy migration=verified counts as complete, healthy apps with unverified migrations stay distinct, and rollout gaps remain waiting until commit and build id observables catch up.
- Documented the manifest schema and operator workflow in docs/release-receipts.md and docs/configuration.md, registered the script in docs/scripts.md, and added shell tests for healthy, unverified-migration, mismatch, rollout-waiting, and watcher-registration behavior.

## Validation

- **Checks passed:** bash tests/fm-release-receipt-check.test.sh (11 scenarios including healthy complete, unverified migration distinction, commit mismatch, Render target, dedupe, stale-build waiting paths, manifest dedupe, watcher arm/disarm, and JSON build-field parsing); live read-only audit confirmed admin build-id URL parsing; prior pipeline intent, rebase, review, test, document, lint, and push steps completed on head 5790e669074efb9ba0369af9e270afec0cada965.
- **Checks not run:** Full live end-to-end path to app=healthy migration=verified for admin-prod; Coolify returned git_commit_sha=HEAD without a 40-character SHA and App DB service-role credentials for project evvrlbeilubeggmrhjgs were unavailable in the gate environment.
- **Evidence and limitations:** Live build-id JSON parsing was verified against admin.laloapp.co; eight operator scenarios were exercised only by unit tests, not against the live product. Hosted pr-communication failed on the prior Intent-shaped live description and is addressed by this narrative replacement while preserving the machine-owned Pipeline section.

## Module-boundary decision

Current module retained: release receipt observation extends the existing watcher check pattern, reuses Coolify, Render, and App DB ledger credential paths already used for the 2026-09-12 admin production release, and keeps manifest data separate from the observer. No parallel scheduler or release control plane was introduced.

## Decision needed

No decision required.
